stories.title: Chennai office market expands to new corridors
stories.summary: Chennai's office market is shifting beyond traditional business districts, with Mount Poonamallee Road and Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam Road emerging as new commercial hubs. Residential development is following this growth, moving toward locations like Mangadu and Madhavaram. Connectivity projects and available land are driving the expansion of the city's footprint.

stories.title: Tier 2 cities mirror metro real estate growth
stories.summary: India's next growth phase is spreading beyond large metros as Tier 2 cities build foundations in infrastructure, employment and digital connectivity. Businesses are scaling across locations more easily as talent becomes more distributed. Rising disposable incomes and local economic activity are supporting a broader consumer economy across the country.

stories.title: Magicbricks Launch India’s Sustainable Real Estate Opportunity Index (SREOI) 2026 - India Education Diary
Magicbricks launches sustainable real estate index
stories.summary: Magicbricks and the School of Planning and Architecture have launched the Sustainable Real Estate Opportunity Index 2026. The index evaluates ten major Indian cities on six parameters, including environmental risk and infrastructure capacity, to assess their readiness for sustainable development and potential to generate risk-adjusted investment returns for stakeholders.

stories.title: India’s Property Data Gaps Complicate Efforts to Build Reliable House Price Index - Realty Plus Magazine
Crore-Plus Homes Now Account for 55% of India’s Housing Sales - Realty Plus Magazine
Why India’s Family Offices are Buying Office Buildings Outright - Realty Plus Magazine
MCD estimates 40 lakh man-hours for building survey
stories.summary: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has estimated that a preliminary safety survey of over 40 lakh buildings will require 40 lakh man-hours. The civic body is currently working on uniform assessment criteria to collate building data across multiple departments. The database remains a work in progress.

stories.title: Proposed Delhi Metro routes include Gurugram link
stories.summary: The proposed Phase V(B) expansion of the Delhi Metro includes eight new routes, featuring a link between Yashobhoomi in Dwarka and Rajiv Chowk in Gurugram. Seven corridors have received approval from the Delhi government and are now awaiting input from the Centre. Connectivity is expected to increase.

stories.title: Keystone Realtors targets 5,000 crore in sales
stories.summary: Keystone Realtors plans to launch housing properties worth 5,000 crore in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region by March. The developer, which sells under the Rustomjee brand, remains bullish on consumer demand after clocking 2,041 crore in sales bookings during the first half of the fiscal year.

stories.title: Keystone Realtors plans 5,000 crore launch pipeline
stories.summary: Keystone Realtors intends to launch 5,000 crore worth of residential properties in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region by March 2027. Chairman Boman Irani cited confidence in ongoing consumer demand. The company continues to operate under the Rustomjee brand as it expands its project pipeline for the fiscal year.

stories.title: Aamir Khan leases three Mumbai apartments
stories.summary: Actor Aamir Khan has leased three luxury apartments in Santacruz, Mumbai, for a combined monthly rent of 38 lakh. The four-year agreement covers units on the 11th, 12th and 14th floors. The largest of the three properties commands a monthly rent of 20 lakh.

stories.title: Consumer commission orders refund for Noida plot
stories.summary: A consumer commission has ordered Bajwa Developers to refund 25.2 lakh to a couple who purchased a plot in 2021. The developer delayed possession and sold the land to another buyer at a higher price. The firm must also pay compensation for mental agony and litigation costs.

stories.title: County Group signs 830 crore deal in Noida
stories.summary: County Group has partnered with Elate Realtors to develop a luxury housing project on a 25-acre land parcel in Noida's Sector 150. The land is valued at 830 crore and was secured through a joint development agreement. The project launch is expected in December 2026.

stories.title: County Group acquires 24.71 acres in Noida
stories.summary: County Group has acquired 24.71 acres in Noida's Sector 150 for 830 crore through a joint development agreement with Elate Realtors. Financed by Tata Capital, the project includes luxury housing and two public sports facilities. The developer plans to launch the residential portion in December 2026.

stories.title: Seven RERA rights for Indian homebuyers
stories.summary: The Real Estate Regulation and Development Act provides protections for homebuyers beyond project registration. These include a five-year defect rectification obligation, restrictions on changing sanctioned plans, and a 10 per cent cap on advances before the sale agreement is registered. Buyers are entitled to seek project information.

stories.title: Telangana RERA penalises 17 builders
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has penalised 17 builders for violations including delayed compliance and failure to provide promised amenities. The authority directed developers to refund buyers and execute sale deeds, rejecting claims that certain buyer grievances were time-barred. The regulator continues to uphold plot registration claims.

stories.title: Bank of America leases 10 lakh sq ft in Hyderabad
stories.summary: Bank of America has leased 10.10 lakh square feet of office space at Mindspace Cyberabad for its global capability centre. The 12-year lease involves a total rental outgo of ₹1,450 crore. The bank is expanding its footprint in the city, which continues to attract large corporate tenants.

stories.title: Bank of America expands Hyderabad office footprint
stories.summary: Bank of America has signed a 12-year lease for over 1 million square feet of space at Mindspace Cyberabad. The transaction, valued at approximately ₹1,500 crore, spans 12 floors of a commercial tower. Hyderabad remains a preferred destination for global capability centres seeking large office campuses.

stories.title: Bank of America signs major Hyderabad office lease
stories.summary: BA Continuum India has leased 1 million square feet of office space at Mindspace Cyberabad for 12 years. The deal, valued at ₹1,450 crore, is one of the year's largest by area. Rent payments for the 12-floor facility are scheduled to commence in January 2027.

stories.title: Retail leasing grows in Delhi-NCR
stories.summary: Retail leasing in Delhi-NCR rose 25 percent to 2.47 million square feet during the first nine months of 2026. The region accounted for 26 percent of total leasing across seven major Indian cities. Better demand from retailers drove the increase in shopping mall and high street activity.

stories.title: PGA Of America Enters India's Real Estate Market, Chennai To Get Major Golf Community By 2029 - NDTV Sports
Delta Electronics targets India revenue growth
stories.summary: Delta Electronics aims to triple its India revenue within five years, citing the acceleration of AI data centre investments. The company expects data centre and telecom business to account for 55 percent of its local revenue. India is currently positioned as Asia's fastest-growing data centre market.

stories.title: JLL Promotes Tanuj Hardikar As City Lead, Office Leasing Advisory, Pune - Realty Plus Magazine
PGA of America plans Chennai golf community
stories.summary: PGA of America is partnering with Vimtra Ventures to develop a branded golf and residential community in Chennai. The project, which includes coaching and club amenities, is scheduled to open in 2029. The initiative marks the organization's entry into India's golf-led real estate market.

stories.title: Airbnb recreates K3G mansion in Mumbai
stories.summary: Airbnb has recreated the Raichand family home from the film Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham in Mumbai to mark the movie's anniversary. The experience will be hosted by cast members and the director from December 1 to 6. Fans are invited to explore the fictional household.

stories.title: Cabinet approves ₹33,660 crore industrial park scheme
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the BHAVYA scheme with a ₹33,660 crore outlay to develop 100 plug-and-play industrial parks. The initiative aims to boost manufacturing and attract investment by creating modern industrial ecosystems. It builds on the existing National Industrial Corridor Development Programme.

stories.title: Aurionpro secures ₹100 crore data centre order
stories.summary: Aurionpro Solutions has won a ₹100 crore order from a global hyperscaler to develop an AI-ready data centre in Southern India. This latest contract brings the company's total order value from the client to over ₹400 crore. The project expands an existing engagement between the two firms.

stories.title: Data centre growth to drive warehousing demand
stories.summary: India's data centre industry is projected to generate demand for 35 million square feet of specialised warehousing space by 2030, according to Savills India. The growth is attributed to AI workloads and cloud adoption. Operator-based IT capacity is expected to exceed 7 GW by the decade's end.

stories.title: NICDC presents Andhra Pradesh industrial nodes
stories.summary: The National Industrial Corridor Development Corporation has detailed the progress of three Greenfield Industrial Smart City projects in Andhra Pradesh. The nodes in Krishnapatnam, Orvakal and Kopparthy cover a combined area of 7,200 acres. Officials briefed ministers on the status of these developments at a recent summit.

stories.title: Oetiker India expands manufacturing capacity
stories.summary: Oetiker India has inaugurated an expanded manufacturing facility to mark 20 years of operations. The company aims to increase production capacity and broaden its technology portfolio to serve customers across India and ASEAN. The investment is intended to strengthen its position as a regional engineering hub.

stories.title: Collins Aerospace builds propeller repair center
stories.summary: Collins Aerospace has begun construction on a propeller maintenance and repair facility in Bengaluru. The center is expected to open in 2029 to service regional and military aircraft. It will be the first facility in India authorized by a foreign equipment manufacturer for this specific work.

stories.title: Nestlé India launches Gurugram corridor initiative
stories.summary: Nestlé India has inaugurated the Clean Corridor Gurugram initiative to improve the upkeep of a 16-km stretch between Ambience Mall and Rajiv Chowk. The project includes mechanised sweeping and beautification. The route serves as a major arterial link for daily commuters in the National Capital Region.

stories.title: Auto, data center supplier to buy scrapped ICE lockup near Detroit Metro Airport - Crain's Detroit
Delhi-Ahmedabad bullet train awaits approval
stories.summary: A proposed 886-km high-speed rail corridor between Delhi and Ahmedabad remains at the planning stage. While a detailed project report exists, the initiative has not received formal sanction or begun construction. The project is intended to link major commercial centres across four states.

stories.title: County Group acquires 24.71-acre Noida land - Construction Week India
Delhi Metro proposes eight new corridors for Phase V(B)
stories.summary: The Delhi Metro has submitted eight proposed corridors for Phase V(B) to the government, aiming to improve connectivity across outer and densely populated areas. Seven of the routes have received local approval and now await a decision from the Centre. The expansion would add 65 stations.

stories.title: Namma Metro begins trial runs on Blue Line
stories.summary: Trial runs have commenced on a 6-km section of the Namma Metro Blue Line between Baiyappanahalli and Doddanekundi. Engineers are currently testing track alignment, power supply, and signalling systems. The corridor is not yet open for passenger service as it undergoes mandatory safety inspections.

stories.title: County Group to develop sports-focused project in Noida
stories.summary: County Group has signed a joint development agreement for a residential project in Noida, expected to launch in December 2026. The developer will also build five sports complexes, including a 5.8-acre facility featuring courts for badminton, basketball, and squash, to serve roughly 8,000 local homebuyers.

stories.title: Delhi-Mumbai bullet train link remains unannounced
stories.summary: While a high-speed rail connection between Delhi and Mumbai could theoretically reduce travel time to under six hours, the proposed Delhi-Ahmedabad corridor is not currently on the list of new projects. The prospect remains a long-term possibility rather than an official travel-time target.

stories.title: Visakhapatnam hosts 31st CII Partnership Summit
stories.summary: The 31st CII Partnership Summit took place in Visakhapatnam on November 12-13. The event gathered policymakers, business leaders, and investors to discuss trade and economic cooperation. Attendees included Union ministers and the leadership of the Andhra Pradesh government.

stories.title: Signature Global expands land bank in Gurugram
stories.summary: Signature Global has signed collaboration agreements for 10.18 acres of land in Sohna, Gurugram. The deal grants development rights for a project with a potential area of 0.86 million square feet. The acquisition aligns with the company's strategy to increase its presence in high-potential locations.

stories.title: Supreme Court protects homebuyers in stalled Bengaluru project
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered that no coercive action be taken against 4,500 homebuyers in a stalled Bengaluru residential project until they receive possession. The buyers have already paid 95 percent of the sale consideration to the developer, which is currently undergoing insolvency proceedings.

stories.title: Centre pushes for uniform builder-buyer agreements
stories.summary: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs has requested an early Supreme Court hearing on a petition pending since 2020. The government seeks to mandate uniform agreements between builders and homebuyers to protect consumers from one-sided terms. The matter is described as having significant public importance.

stories.title: Supreme Court rules against UP Housing Board demand
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has upheld an Allahabad High Court decision to quash a Rs 388 crore demand notice issued by the Uttar Pradesh Housing Board to Gaursons India. The court rejected the state's challenge regarding the land exchange dispute, effectively setting aside the board's financial claim.

stories.title: Retired officials testify in 2007 Bengaluru land case
stories.summary: Two retired civil servants have testified in a special court regarding the 2007 release of 2.24 acres of land involving Union minister HD Kumaraswamy. One official stated she had previously objected to a similar de-notification plan in 2005. The case is being handled by Lokayukta police.

stories.title: NHB proposes new affordable housing loan classification
stories.summary: The National Housing Bank is consulting with ministries to create a separate affordable housing loan category for Tier-II and Tier-III cities. The proposal suggests a Rs 15 lakh loan limit, as officials argue the current Rs 25 lakh benchmark does not account for regional price differences.

stories.title: NHB seeks lower affordable housing loan limits for smaller cities
stories.summary: The National Housing Bank is considering a proposal to classify loans up to Rs 15 lakh as affordable housing in Tier-II and Tier-III cities. Managing director Sanjay Shukla stated that the bank is working to refine these norms to better reflect local housing affordability.

stories.title: Developers cite regulatory hurdles in Delhi Master Plan 2047
stories.summary: Real estate executives have identified policy gaps and overlapping agency responsibilities as primary obstacles to implementing Delhi's Master Plan 2047. The plan, notified in August, estimates a need for 4 million additional homes, but developers warn that regulatory uncertainty could hinder progress.

stories.title: Office furniture market projected to reach USD 7.78 billion
stories.summary: India's office furniture market is expected to grow to USD 7.78 billion by 2031, according to Mordor Intelligence. The sector is supported by rising commercial office absorption, which reached 66.4 million square feet in the first nine months of 2026, an 8 percent increase year-on-year.

stories.title: Minister praises speed of subsidized housing development
stories.summary: Minister of Housing and Settlement Areas Maruarar Sirait stated that subsidized housing development is becoming faster and higher in quality. He noted that current projects include complete facilities and organized neighborhoods, claiming they now offer amenities comparable to commercial housing developments.

stories.title: Motilal Oswal targets Rs 3,000 crore for office fund
stories.summary: Motilal Oswal Alternates is launching a fund to invest in early-stage Grade A office developments across six tier-I markets. The firm aims to raise Rs 3,000 crore, citing a scarcity of institutional capital in the early stages of large-scale commercial real estate projects.

stories.title: Motilal Oswal Alts launches Rs 1,500-cr commercial real estate fund, targets 23% IRR - Moneycontrol.com
India's listed REITs distribute ₹3,234 crore to unitholders
stories.summary: India's six listed real estate investment trusts distributed over ₹3,234 crore to more than 525,000 unitholders in the second quarter of 2026-27. The Indian REITs Association attributed the payouts to strong office demand from Global Capability Centres and front-office enterprises. The sector now manages over ₹3.30 lakh crore.

stories.title: NLC India Renewables files for ₹3,300 crore IPO
stories.summary: NLC India Renewables has filed a draft prospectus for a ₹3,300 crore initial public offering. The state-run company plans to use proceeds from the fresh issue to repay debt and expand its green energy portfolio. SBI Capital Markets and HDFC Bank are among those managing the offering.

stories.title: Pecan, HDFC Capital partner for Mumbai commercial developments - Construction Week India
Pecan Realty and HDFC Capital partner for Mumbai project
stories.summary: Pecan Realty and HDFC Capital have formed a partnership to develop commercial real estate in Mumbai. The first project is a ₹10 billion mixed-use development in Andheri East. The collaboration aims to create a platform for institutional-quality commercial assets, starting with a 400,000 sq ft site near the airport.

stories.title: Weichert, Realtors joins Google Listings Program
stories.summary: Weichert, Realtors has joined the Google Listings Program, allowing its company-owned office listings to appear in mobile search carousels. The program displays property details and brokerage attribution for offices across five states, including New Jersey and New York. Consumers can tap through to view additional home information.

stories.title: Pulley Raises $64M to Accelerate Every Phase of Real Estate Development
stories.summary: Pulley, the development system that drives projects from concept to construction, has announced $64 million in new funding, comprising a $41 million Series B led by Jump Capital, with participation from Catalyst Investors, and a $23 million Series A led by CRV and Susa Ventures. The investment will support the

stories.title: Pulley raises $64 million for real estate development
stories.summary: Pulley has raised $64 million across two funding rounds to expand its permitting services and develop new products. The company, which combines AI technology with regulatory data to secure project approvals, reported fivefold year-over-year growth in annual recurring revenue. It aims to help developers build at greater speed.

stories.title: Beeline Holdings to acquire blockchain platform TYTL
stories.summary: Beeline Holdings has entered a definitive agreement to acquire TYTL Corp in an all-stock transaction. The merger aims to expand Beeline's operations beyond digital mortgage origination into home equity investments and tokenized real estate securities. Existing shareholders are expected to retain 60 percent of the combined company.

How real estate agents close crypto deals for homebuyers
stories.summary: CryptEscrow, a Miami company that converts cryptocurrency into U.S. dollars for real estate purchases, closed 12 transactions worth more than $20 million over four months earlier this year, according to founder John Ioannou Jr. Ioannou told Inman the deals included purchases from $1 million to $4.2 million, with buyers from

stories.title: Sarvam's token factory stirs debate on India's 'sovereign' AI push
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based AI startup Sarvam has drawn scrutiny online after its launch of Token Factory, an inference platform that allows developers and businesses to access global AI models hosted on local computing infrastructure. The single bone of contention, it seems, is over the company selling access to six Chinese AI models

stories.title: Apple Maps rolls out features with Indian Railways’ integration & more: How are these different from Google Maps? | Mint
stories.summary: Apple is stepping up its efforts to challenge Google Maps in India with a major upgrade to its navigation service, introducing Indian Railways journey planning, augmented reality (AR) walking directions, interactive street-level imagery and more than 300 three-dimensional landmarks. Announced on Wednesday, the revamped Apple Maps experience brings several India-focused

stories.title: India office furniture market projected to reach $7.78 billion
stories.summary: India's office furniture market is expected to grow from $4.81 billion in 2025 to $7.78 billion by 2031, according to Mordor Intelligence. The report cites rising commercial real estate activity and the expansion of Global Capability Centres as primary drivers for the shift toward ergonomic and modular workplace solutions.

stories.title: Low-carbon materials, housing innovation highlight MaRS Climate Impact
stories.summary: Decarbonizing building materials and scaling cleantech adoption in the housing sector were among the priorities discussed at MaRS Climate Impact 2026, as industry leaders explored solutions to Canada's housing and climate challenges. Buildings account for approximately 40 per cent of global greenhouse gas emissions, according to one estimate, making their

stories.title: WindowMaster used on Manchester’s first net zero carbon office building
stories.summary: Plot 9A at First Street is now Manchester’s first net zero carbon office building in operation. The 130,900 sq ft hub for 2,600 civil servants achieved a NABERS 5.5-star rating and BREEAM Excellent certification. Sustainability targets and commercial quality standards are now officially compatible, according to the project developers.

stories.title: Real Estate & Construction News Roundup (11/18/26) to Construction Input Prices Increase, Officials Propose New Framewor
SignatureGlobal secures 10.18 acres in Gurugram for 0.86 mn sq ft project
stories.summary: SignatureGlobal India Limited has secured development rights for 10.18 acres of land in Sohna, Gurugram. The acquisition provides approximately 0.86 million square feet of potential developable area. The agreements were signed on November 19, 2026, following a split in ownership between the parent company and a subsidiary.

stories.title: Explainer: Green hydrogen and India’s clean energy transition
stories.summary: India aims to produce at least 5 million metric tonnes of green hydrogen annually by 2030 under the National Green Hydrogen Mission. The government views the fuel as a pillar for energy security and industrial decarbonisation, supporting a broader national target to reach net-zero emissions by 2070.

stories.title: Sinopec hosts side event at COP31
stories.summary: Sinopec hosted a side event at COP31 to discuss its World and China Energy Outlook 2060. The company projects global energy-related carbon emissions will peak around 2030. It also released a report on how green liquid fuels might reduce emissions from the aviation and shipping sectors.

stories.title: Reflections on the just energy transition at COP31
stories.summary: Discussions at COP31 highlighted that a just energy transition requires addressing global inequalities alongside decarbonisation. Sessions focused on the socioeconomic consequences of climate action and the need to ensure the benefits of renewable energy, such as solar and wind, are distributed equitably between different countries.

stories.title: Net Zero Energy advancing planning application for plant near Carlow village
stories.summary: Net Zero Energy is preparing a planning application for a 600-megawatt hydrogen storage plant near Rathoe. The company claims the facility would displace 180,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide. Local residents have described themselves as a community under siege, citing concerns regarding the safety of the proposed technology.

stories.title: Protium's 70MW Teesside Hydrogen Hub clears due diligence
stories.summary: Protium’s 70MW Teesside Hydrogen Hub has successfully completed due diligence as part of a government funding round. The project, which focuses on hydrogen energy infrastructure, reached this milestone on November 19, 2026. The company continues to position itself within the industrial hydrogen sector.

Princeton Review names Salisbury University among top 35 sustainable schools
stories.summary: Salisbury University has been included in The Princeton Review’s Guide to Green Colleges for the 17th consecutive year. The ranking, produced in partnership with the U.S. Green Building Council, highlights the school’s environmental and sustainability programs. The university remains proud of its status as a green campus.

stories.summary: FF News is the fintech news network covering payments, insurtech, tradetech and capital markets.

Broadstone Net Lease adds $21 million to its development pipeline
stories.summary: Broadstone Net Lease has secured land and started construction on two build-to-suit developments for Hobby Lobby and Academy Sports. The projects were sourced through off-market transactions and are expected to deliver in the fourth quarter of 2027. The company continues to expand its industrial property portfolio.

stories.title: Hillwood to add nearly 355,000 square feet of industrial space in Haslet
stories.summary: Hillwood plans to build two speculative industrial buildings totaling 354,593 square feet at AllianceTexas. Construction is scheduled to begin in December with completion expected by August 2027. The developer cited sustained demand for Class A space as the primary driver for this next phase of expansion.

stories.title: Manhattan-based firm offloads three Upper East Side apartment buildings for $24M - Crain's New York
Baltimore reaches Harborplace redevelopment deal with MCB Real Estate
stories.summary: Baltimore Mayor Brandon Scott announced an agreement with MCB Real Estate to redevelop Harborplace. The city claims the project will generate $2 billion in economic activity and triple current tax revenue. The Board of Estimates will vote on the proposed deal on December 2.

stories.title: Sagard Real Estate buys medical outpatient property in Washington
stories.summary: Sagard Real Estate acquired the Franciscan Medical Pavilion in Puyallup, Washington, for its diversified core real estate fund. The firm says it targets assets that serve essential community needs. This purchase marks the portfolio's first investment in the outpatient healthcare sector.

stories.title: Advanced Real Estate buys Ontario apartment complex for $56.2 million
stories.summary: Advanced Real Estate purchased the 253-unit Casitas Apartments in Ontario, California, for approximately $56.2 million. The firm plans to renovate units and upgrade property amenities. It assumed the existing Freddie Mac loan to complete the acquisition. The renovations are now scheduled to begin.

stories.title: Sagard Real Estate adds medical building to core fund
stories.summary: Sagard Real Estate has purchased the 20,614-square-foot Franciscan Medical Pavilion in Puyallup, Washington. The property is fully leased to two tenants who have occupied the space since 2009. The firm did not disclose the financial terms of the transaction.
